# Mystral

> Mystral is an esoteric platform: natal charts, lunar calendar, zodiac compatibility, Tarot, runes, numerology, and the Destiny Matrix. Calculations are real (Swiss Ephemeris astronomy, classical numerology, cross-checked formulas); explanatory text is written by language models grounded in that calculated data. Available in Russian (default) and English, Spanish, Portuguese, Turkish, Ukrainian (under /en, /es, /pt, /tr, /uk).

Mystral is built and maintained by a single independent developer, not an agency or a fund — see /about for who's behind it and what each tool's calculation is based on.

## Product pages

- [Natal chart](https://mystral.space/natal-chart): Free natal chart calculation — planets, houses, aspects, ascendant — via real astronomical ephemeris data.
- [Lunar calendar](https://mystral.space/lunar-calendar): The Moon's current phase and lunar day, calculated astronomically and interpreted through the traditional 30-day lunar calendar.
- [Compatibility](https://mystral.space/compatibility): Zodiac, element, numerology, Chinese zodiac and synastry-based compatibility between two people.
- [Destiny Matrix](https://mystral.space/destiny-matrix): An eight-point octagram (personal and ancestral squares) calculated from a birth date, with all 22 arcana explained as light/shadow energy.

## Reference sections

- [Zodiac signs](https://mystral.space/zodiac): All 12 zodiac signs — traits, compatibility, dates.
- [Tarot cards](https://mystral.space/tarot): All 78 Tarot cards, upright and reversed meanings.
- [Runes](https://mystral.space/runes): The 24 Elder Futhark runes — meaning and divination use.
- [Numerology](https://mystral.space/numerology): Life path numbers and their meaning.
